description: Add a text layer (Layer > New > Text, or the Horizontal and Vertical Type tools): point text, or paragraph text in a box, horizontal or vertical, optionally named and placed

boxSize.description: Paragraph text: [width, height] of the box in pixels. Default half the composition size

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

kind.description: point text (default) or paragraph text in a box

orientation.description: Horizontal Type tool (default) or Vertical Type tool

position.description: [x, y] in pixels from the composition's top-left

text.description: The text; line breaks start new lines

name: add_text_layer
title: Add Text Layer
